hypothesis: alpha2 uses ai_equity_alpha + SLOW_AND_FAST + convexity(power5+centered) + earnings surprise. All non-alpha2 datasets failed under SLOW_AND_FAST (peeling effect). NEW APPROACH: analyst7 (Broker Estimates) + SUBINDUSTRY neutralization + simple rank/delta templates (NO convexity).
